chapters.title_ar: كان يمسح مقدم رأسه مرة واحدة
chapters.title_en: He would wipe the front of his head once

chapters.title_ar: كان يمسح يافوخه مرة

chapters.title_ar: أنه كان يمسح رأسه ثلاثا

chapters.title_ar: أيجزئني أن أمسح رأسي مسحة قَالَ نعم
chapters.title_en: Let me wipe my head with a wet cloth, he said, Yes

chapters.title_ar: لو كنت على شاطئ الفرات ما زدت على مسحة

chapters.title_ar: سألت الحكم وحمادا عن مسح الرأس فقالا مرة

chapters.title_ar: أتانا النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فتوضأ ومسح برأسه مرتين

chapters.title_ar: أن النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مسح رأسه مرة واحدة

chapters.title_ar: كانوا إِذا توضئوا مسحوا رؤوسهم ثلاثا

chapters.title_ar: أكان أنس بن مالك إِذا مسح رأسه يقلب شعره قَالَ لا

chapters.title_ar: يمسح رأسه هكذا من مقدمه إِلَى مؤخره ثم رد يديه إِلَى مقدمه
chapters.title_en: He wipes his head like this, from the front to the back, then turns his hands to the front

chapters.title_ar: فتوضأ ومسح رأسه بدأ بمؤخره ثم رد يديه على ناصيته
chapters.title_en: He performed ablution and wiped his head, beginning from the back and then bringing his hands forward to his forehead

chapters.title_ar: كان يمسح رأسه هكذا ووضع أيوب كفه وسط رأسه ثم أمرها إِلَى مقدم رأسه
chapters.title_en: He would wipe his head thus, and Ayyub placed his palm in the middle of his head then moved it to the front of his head

chapters.title_ar: من قال إذا حلف على دون الأربع فهو مول
chapters.title_en: Whoever says: 'If he swears less than four times, he is a liar'

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يولي من امرأته ثم يريد فيفيء إليها فيمنعه من ذلك مرض أو عذر فيفيء بلسانه من قال هو رجعة
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who swears an oath of abstinence from his wife, then wishes to return to her but is prevented by illness or an excuse, so he returns to her verbally: who said it is a revocation.

chapters.title_ar: من قال لا فيء له إلا الجماع
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, 'There is no booty except from the [Muslim] community’s collective property (fay' al-jamāʿ),'

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يولي من الأمة كم إيلاؤه منها
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who swears an oath of abstinence from a slave-girl: how much of an oath is it from her?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يولي من امرأته ثم يطلقها
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who swears an oath of abstinence from his wife, then divorces her.

chapters.title_ar: من قال الإيلاء في الرضى والغضب ومن قال في الغضب
chapters.title_en: "Whoever mentions *‘īlā’ (a form of oath-breaking) in both satisfaction and anger, and whoever mentions it specifically in anger"

chapters.title_ar: من قال لا إيلاء إلا بحلف
chapters.title_en: Whoever said: 'There is no ila' except with an oath'

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يولي من المرأة فتمضي العدة ثم يطلق
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who swears an oath of abstinence from a woman, then the waiting period passes, then he divorces her.

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في العبد يولي من الحرة
chapters.title_en: What they said about a slave who swears an oath of abstinence from a free woman.

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يولي من امرأته فتمضي عدة الإيلاء قالوا له أن يخطبها في العدة
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who swears an oath of abstinence from his wife, then the waiting period of abstinence passes: they told him to propose to her during the waiting period.

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا فيه إذا آلى من امرأته تكون لها نفقة أم لا
chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who makes a vow (*ʿahd*) with his wife: Is she entitled to maintenance (*nafaqah*)?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يحلف أن لا يبني بامرأته في موضع من قال ليس بمول
chapters.title_en: "What they said about a man who swears an oath not to build with his wife in a place where it is said, ‘It is not a *mawlā* (client/patron).’"

chapters.title_ar: من قال في المطلقة ثلاثا لها النفقة
chapters.title_en: Whoever said: 'The thrice-divorced woman is entitled to maintenance'

chapters.title_ar: من قال إذا طلقها ثلاثا ليس لها نفقة
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, *'If a man divorces his wife three times, she has no maintenance (*nafqah*) due to him'*

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا فيه إذا طلقها وهي حامل من قال عليه النفقة
chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who divorces his wife while she is pregnant: Who is responsible for her maintenance?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في المختلعة الحامل من قال لها النفقة

chapters.title_ar: من قال لا نفقة للمختلعة الحامل
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, 'There is no charity for a pregnant woman who has abandoned her husband,'

chapters.title_ar: العبد يطلق امرأته وهي حامل من قال عليه النفقة
chapters.title_en: The slave divorces his wife while she is pregnant, who is responsible for the expenses?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا إذا فرض لها فلا متعة لها
chapters.title_en: What they said if marriage is contracted for her, then there is no enjoyment (of marriage) for her

chapters.title_en: What they said about the highest and lowest limits of mutʿah

chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who divorces his wife while she is suffering from istiḥāḍah: by what does she observe her waiting period?

chapters.title_en: What did they say about the women who are divorced due to a man saying, 'Do not exceed the limit with blood': how many times should they sit until their husband covers them?

chapters.title_en: What did they say about the menstruating woman when it becomes clear that she is menstruating?

chapters.title_en: What they said about what the aqrāʾ are

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding the waiting period of the umm al-walad (a slave woman who bore her master’s child)—those who said it is three menstrual cycles if he dies

chapters.title_en: Whoever said: 'Her waiting period is four months and ten days'

chapters.title_ar: من قال عدة أم الولد حيضة
chapters.title_en: Whoever said: 'The waiting period of the mother of a child is one menstrual cycle'

chapters.title_en: What they said about the umm al-walad when she is emancipated: how long is her waiting period?

chapters.title_en: What did they say about the number of the ummah when a woman is divorced?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الأمة تكون للرجل فيعتقها تكون عليها عدة
chapters.title_en: What they said about the female slave who is owned by a man and he emancipates her: she has a waiting period upon her

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who has an *umma* (slave woman) under him, divorces her (*taṭlīq*) with a *taṭlīq* (conditional divorce), then frees her (*taʿqīq*)

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل تكون تحته الأمة فيموت ثم تعتق بعد موته
chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who has an *umma* under him, dies, and is freed (*taʿqīq*) after his death

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في المرتد عن الإسلام هل على امرأته عدة
chapters.title_en: "What they said about an apostate (*murtadd*) from Islam—does his wife have an *ʿiddah*?"

chapters.title_en: Whoever said: 'The divorce of a Jewish or Christian woman is like that of a Muslim woman, and her waiting period is like hers'

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يطلق امرأته وفي بطنها ولدان فتضع أحدهما
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who divorces his wife while she is pregnant with two children and she miscarries one

chapters.title_ar: من قال إذا وضعت أحدهما فقد حلت
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, *'When one of them (*the two wives*) is placed (*waṭiʿa*), she is lawful'*

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا أين تعتد من قال في بيتها

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who divorces his wife while she is in a rented house: What should she do?

chapters.title_en: On the Deceased Wife: Whether She Observes ʿIddah in Her Husband’s House

chapters.title_ar: من رخص للمتوفى عنها زوجها أن تخرج
chapters.title_en: Who permitted the deceased woman to leave her husband

chapters.title_ar: في رجل طلق امرأته فحاضت حيضة أو حيضتين
chapters.title_en: Regarding a man who divorced his wife and she menstruated once or twice

chapters.title_en: Who said, *'He is more entitled to her return until she purifies herself from the third menstruation*’

chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who divorces his wife, informs her of the divorce, and then reconciles with her without her knowing about the reconciliation until he marries her again

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في المرأة يطلقها زوجها ثم يموت عنها من أي يوم تعتد
chapters.title_en: "What they said about a woman her husband divorces, then he dies—from which day does she observe her *ʿiddah*?"

chapters.title_en: Who said, *'From the day the news reaches him*’

chapters.title_ar: من قال إذا شهدت الشهود فالعدة من ذلك اليوم
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, *'When you witness testimony, the waiting period (*iddah*) begins from that day*'

chapters.title_en: What they said about a slave who flees and has a wife: is his fleeing considered a divorce?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في المطلقة يستأذن عليها زوجها أم لا
chapters.title_en: What did they say about the divorced woman: should her husband ask for her permission or not?

chapters.title_ar: من قال لا تخرج من بيتها إلا بإذن زوجها إذا كان يملك الرجعة
chapters.title_en: Whoever says, 'A woman may not leave her home without her husband’s permission if he has the right to divorce her,'

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في المتوفى عنها ما تجتنب من الزينة في عدتها
chapters.title_en: What they said about a woman whose husband has died: what adornments she must avoid during her waiting period.

chapters.title_ar: من قال ينفق عليها من جميع المال

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في أم الولد يموت عنها وهي حامل من أين ينفق عليها
chapters.title_en: What they said about the umm al-walad who dies while she is pregnant: from where is her maintenance provided?

chapters.title_en: In the man who releases his wife and keeps it secret until the waiting period is over

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يعجز عن نفقة امرأته يجبر على أن يطلق امرأته أم لا واختلافهم في ذلك
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who is unable to support his wife, whether he should divorce her or not, and their differences in this matter

chapters.title_en: What they said about a woman who leaves her house in disobedience to her husband: is she entitled to maintenance?

chapters.title_en: On the man who has a wife on two, then divorces her when he is sick, the third.

chapters.title_en: "What they said about a man who swears an oath involving divorce or manumission (*‘itāq*), then forgets and performs the act."

chapters.title_en: What they said about two men who swear by divorce regarding something without knowing what it is.

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man or woman asking their child to divorce their spouse

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who has multiple wives and divorces one, then dies—whether he knows which one was divorced

chapters.title_en: "What they said about a man who swears by divorce to strike his son or to marry another woman while his wife is alive, then dies before doing so."

chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who divorces his wife three times during his illness and she dies several times during his illness

chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who says to his concubine, 'You are forbidden to me.'

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man against whom three people testified that he had divorced his wife in multiple instances

chapters.title_en: Regarding a man who said to his wife, 'You are not lawful for me'

chapters.title_ar: في رجل أخذ لصا فكلم فيه فحلف بالطلاق فغلبه فانفلت منه
chapters.title_en: Regarding a man who caught a thief and interceded for him, then swore by divorce but was overpowered and the thief escaped

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يزوج ابنته وهي صغيرة
chapters.title_en: "What they said about a man who marries off his daughter while she is still a minor."

chapters.title_ar: في رجل قال لامرأته إذا حضت فأنت طالق
chapters.title_en: Regarding a man who said to his wife, 'When you menstruate, you are divorced'

chapters.title_en: On divorce in polytheism (shirk) if one sees it permissible

chapters.title_en: The saying: ‘And it is not lawful for them to conceal what Allah has created in their wombs,’

chapters.title_ar: من قال لامرأته أنت طالق
chapters.title_en: Who said, *'To his wife: *‘You are divorced’*’

chapters.title_en: On how much is spent on a *mutalliqah* (divorced woman)

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يطلق امرأته ولها ولد صغير
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who divorces his wife and she has a small child

chapters.title_en: What they said about guardians and paternal uncles: which of them is more entitled to the child?

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الرجل يقول لامرأته لأغيظنك
chapters.title_en: What they said about a man who says to his wife, 'I will vex you.'

chapters.title_ar: في الرجل يطلق أو يموت وفي منزله متاع
chapters.title_en: In the man who releases his wife or dies and has property in his house

chapters.title_ar: ما قالوا في الصبي يموت أبوه وأمه وله مال رضاعه من أين يكون

chapters.title_en: "Chapter: On His Saying, *And the Heir Has the Like of That* [Qur’ān 4:12]"

chapters.title_en: "Whoever says suckling (*ar-riḍā‘*) applies to men but not women"

chapters.title_en: What they said regarding a man who divorces his wife while she has a nursing infant

chapters.title_en: "What they said about a woman for whom a portion of her daughter’s wealth is prescribed (*i.e.*, inheritance or support*)"
